entities.summary: Ze'ev Ben Aryeh is an Israeli diplomat and the former Israeli ambassador to Belarus, who pleaded guilty to illegally tipping off his long-term friend Foreign Minister Avigdor Lieberman to a criminal investigation being conducted into his affairs.
